public_rationale: The blanket assertion faces material counterevidence: Contrary reported HeyGen profitable in May 2025. But neither the claim nor that report defines the profit measure. The supplied rules prohibit a supported or contradicted money-claim verdict when the claim's accounting basis is unknown. This hold should not be read as evidence that no profitable generative AI company existed.
limitations: The target quarter is an interpretation of an undated ongoing observation.
Private-company profitability reports may use different financial measures.
